ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a fourth-generation Dot, so this older model adds little for me.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought a second-generation Show 5 and its stand, so I would skip this older version.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger display interests me, but I would use my recently purchased Show 5 before adding another screen.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K, brilliant 4K streaming quality, TV and smart home controls, free and live TV; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a 4K Max, and I have no current need for another streaming stick.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: SanDisk 256GB Extreme microSDXC UHS-I Memory Card with Adapter - Up to 160MB/s, C10, U3, V30, 4K, A2, Micro SD - SDSQXA1-256G-GN6MA; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: I use memory cards and recently bought a card reader, but I would check whether I need this capacity and speed first.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blink Video Doorbell | Two-way audio, HD video, motion and chime app alerts, and Alexa enabled — wired or wire-free (White); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add front-door alerts alongside my Alexa devices; my earlier door alarm purchase makes the security function appealing.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Ring Charging Station for Quick Release Battery Packs; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no known Ring battery devices, so I have no use for this charging accessory.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa in the car sounds useful, but my home Alexa purchases do not establish a need for another car device right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blink Mini – Compact indoor plug-in smart security camera, 1080p HD video, night vision, motion detection, two-way audio, easy set up, Works with Alexa – 3 cameras (Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa-compatible security cameras interest me, but I would start with the doorbell before committing to three indoor cameras.
